title: Kinetic language file
description: A lang/<tag>.json of a Kinetic content folder: one language's translation of the manifest's text. See docs/content-format.md § Translations for semantics.

$schema.description: optional address of the JSON Schema an editor checks this file against; the player and validator ignore the value

language.description: this file's language; equal to the file name without .json and listed in the manifest's languages, which the validator enforces

name.description: optional name of the language in itself, as the Language control lists it (absent: the player names it with Intl.DisplayNames)

title.description: optional translation of the manifest's title

version.description: optional translation of the manifest's version

items.description: item id -> the translation of that item's text; the id must name an item with text, which the validator enforces

speakers.description: speaker exactly as the manifest's items give it -> the name drawn; the key must be a speaker of an item with text, which the validator enforces

decisions.description: decision id -> the translation of its prompt and route labels; ids must resolve, which the validator enforces

voice.description: optional recorded voice lines in this language; see docs/content-format.md § Translations

tracks.description: track id -> track, exactly as a manifest audio.tracks entry; the ids are this file's own, apart from the manifest's

items.description: item id -> the id of the track in this file's voice.tracks that speaks the item's translated text; the item must have text and the track must exist, which the validator enforces

keepOriginalVoice.description: true: the base recordings of voice lines play under this language's text, like subtitles

languageTag.description: a BCP 47 tag, language[-Script][-REGION][-variant...], in canonical casing: de, zh-Hans, pt-BR, es-419

durationSeconds.description: the track's length; authoritative, the player never reads the audio element's duration (WebKit misreports Ogg durations)

startSeconds.description: where a play starts; default 0; less than durationSeconds, which the validator enforces

loopStartSeconds.description: where a loop restarts; default: the track's startSeconds, so a loop restarts where the track started; less than durationSeconds, which the validator enforces

loop.description: whether the track loops when it plays as music or ambience; default true

path.description: a media file's path relative to the content folder root, forward-slash separated. Every segment is [A-Za-z0-9._-] and starts with a letter or digit, so there are no empty or dot-leading segments, no "..", no absolute path, no backslash, no drive letter or URL scheme, and no whitespace. Subfolders (the converter writes `media/<h[:2]>/<h>.<ext>`, `h` the sha256 of the shipped bytes) are allowed and optional; the last segment is still a flat file name — an id-shaped stem (a 64-hex digest fits), at most one derivative suffix (`.fNNN`, `.poster`, `.last`, `.thumb`), then the extension. `imagePath` adds the browser image format extension list, `audioPath` the audio one; `videoPath` adds none.

audioPath.description: an audio file: mp3, m4a, wav, flac or webm. Ogg (ogg, oga, opus) passes the schema, and the validator warns about it: Safari plays Ogg only from 18.4 (macOS 15.4) and WebKit's decode of Vorbis in Ogg loses its first 128 samples.

text.description: the translated string; plain text, never HTML; Ren'Py text tags apply in item text, prompts and labels, as in the manifest (docs/content-format.md, Text tags)

from.description: optional first 8 lowercase hex digits of the SHA-256 of the base string's UTF-8 bytes the translation was made from; the validator warns when the base has changed since

prompt.description: translation of the decision's prompt; shorter than 200 characters, which the validator enforces

routes.description: route id, unique within this decision -> the translation of its label; shorter than 120 characters, which the validator enforces
